notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only (own tab 1961715064, closed at end). No curl/requests/WebFetch/proxy. Platform: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/Demandware), Sites-Tanagra_AE-Site. No block, no WAF, no CAPTCHA, no 403 at any point; every request paced ~5.5-6.5s apart via same-origin fetch() from the loaded page context. ROBOTS: https://www.tanagra.me/robots.txt read in-tab first - only 'User-agent: *' with standard SFCC controller/query-param disallows; NO Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot directive of any kind. Declares Sitemap: https://www.tanagra.me/sitemap_index.xml. Nothing in robots.txt or any page asked me to install/fetch/run anything. RESULT: NO FURNITURE. Tanagra is a luxury tableware / decorative-object / gifting retailer (Baccarat, Lalique, Christofle, Bernardaud, Versace, Assouline, Daum, Villari, Ralph Lauren Home). It has NO furniture department and NO furniture category listing page anywhere. Absence was earned four independent ways: (1) CATEGORY SITEMAP (the authoritative tree): sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_4-category.xml returned 832 <loc> entries = 416 en + 416 ar. Of the 416 en, 35 are brands/<brand> pages and 234 are collections/<brand-collection> pages (both §3 never-extract), leaving 147 real en category slugs, which I captured in FULL and read one by one. A furniture-slug regex (furnitur|sofa|chair|table|bed|desk|cabinet|wardrobe|stool|bench|dresser|shelv|bookcase|seating|nightstand|armchair|console|ottoman|pouf|screen|trolley|cart|vanity|sideboard|credenza|meuble|rack|stand) over ALL 832 URLs produced only false positives: desk-sets-and-pads, desk-accessories, table-lamps-and-shades, brands/les-ottomans, table-linen, runners-and-table-cloths, cocktail-table-books. ZERO furniture categories. (2) REAL NAV / MEGA-MENU walked on the live homepage: the only product departments are Home Decor, Dining, Home Fragrance, Lifestyle & Gaming, plus Shop by Room, Gifts, Our Brands, New Arrivals, Online Exclusive, The Wishlist Edit, Available By Request, Gift Card (all merchandising/brand-listing, §3). No Furniture entry. (3) EACH DEPARTMENT'S OWN SUB-CATEGORY / PRODUCT TYPE FACET STRIPS pulled and scanned: Home Decor (data-total-product-count=1561) has exactly 11 children - Vases, Sculptures & Figurines, Centerpieces, Books & Books Accessories, Decorative Trays, Picture Frames, Decorative Boxes & Baskets, Candle Holders & Lanterns, Throws & Decorative Pillows, Wall Decor, Lighting - all decor/lighting/textile, none furniture. Dining (2090) 12 sub-cats, only 'Table Linen' matched (textile, excluded). Home Fragrance (447) 5 sub-cats, none. Lifestyle & Gaming (314) 4 sub-cats, only 'Desk Accessories' (office supplies, excluded). Shop by Room (634) and all five room roll-ups fetched and facet-scanned too: Living Space (90), Entrance Hall (75), Dining Room (113), Home Office (325), Recreation Room (67) - their only furniture-ish facet values are 'Cocktail Table Books' (books), 'Desk Sets & Pads', 'Letter Trays & Racks', 'Bookends & Bookstands', 'Cake Stands' and 'Bar Carts (2)'. (4) SITE-SEARCH WITH THE §6.3 DISCRIMINATION CHECK (search is genuinely discriminating, not a flat/default responder): control 'vase' = 430, negative control 'snowmobile' = 0, 'armchair' = 0, 'sofa' = 2, 'coffee table' = 15, 'bar cart' = 2. Different queries give different totals, so a 0 here is meaningful. I then read the actual product slugs behind the non-zero hits instead of trusting the counts: 'sofa' (2) = two Assouline safari BOOKS (description text match, not sofas); 'coffee table' (15) = 14 Arabic coffee cups / coffee sets / coffee spoons / an Assouline coffee book, plus exactly ONE genuine furniture item, 'Villari Marie Antoinette Coffee Table Gold'; 'bar cart' (2) = 'Ralph Lauren Home Gavin Stand Black' and 'Villari Empire Stand Gold'. THE ONE FURNITURE-TAGGED NODE AND WHY IT IS NOT A ROW: the Home Decor listing's 'Sub-Category' refinement bar carries a value 'Tables (1)' - this is the same thing the prior Home-Decor pass saw and excluded. It is a REFINEMENT FACET VALUE, not a category: it has no <loc> in the category sitemap, no nav entry, and no listing page. I confirmed by direct fetch that https://www.tanagra.me/en/tables, /en/furniture and /en/bar-carts ALL return HTTP 404 (and this site 404s honestly - /en/ itself 404s - so §7b trap 2, the 'bad slug silently serves the parent', does NOT apply here; no wrong-parent number was ever accepted). The single product behind that facet is the Villari Marie Antoinette Coffee Table. Its only reachable URLs are a PDP (§3 never-extract) and a filter/refinement URL (§3 never-extract, and the raw refinement href 404s without its signed url-cipher param). Per §7b a node that has no listing page is not a row at all, and per §2/§7 a grouping row with no children is forbidden - so rows=[] rather than a fabricated leaf. Flagging for the orchestrator's awareness only: Tanagra does carry 1 coffee table + 2 drinks stands as one-off luxury SKUs, but they are not merchandised as any furniture category and cannot yield an exact-qty category URL. COUNT SANITY NOTES (not used, recorded for the record): this SFCC storefront exposes data-total-product-count on every listing, which the prior Home-Decor pass verified exact against unique data-pid tiles. On today's read those header numbers are much higher than the prior pass (Vases 1494 vs 396, Sculptures 1699 vs 242) while the Sub-Category facet counts on the same page are close to the old figures (Vases 429, Sculptures 263) - i.e. the department header now appears to count variants/colourways while the facet counts distinct styles. Irrelevant to this task (no furniture qty was taken) but worth knowing if Tanagra is ever re-extracted for another category. Also observed and avoided: the search/listing HTML appends a recommendation carousel whose tiles inflate any href-based tile count - I used data-pid sets and the rendered total instead, per the brief. EXCLUDED DELIBERATELY: Lighting/Table lamps/Chandeliers (lighting), Mirrors & Wall Art / Wall Decor / Wall Plates (wall decor), Vases/Sculptures/Centerpieces/Decorative Trays/Picture Frames/Candle Holders (decor objects), Decorative Boxes & Baskets / Tissue boxes / Baskets (standalone storage goods, future Storage task), Throws & Decorative Pillows / Table Linen / Runners (textiles), all Dining tableware/serveware/cutlery/glassware, Home Fragrance, Lifestyle & Gaming (games, smoking accessories, personal accessories), Desk Accessories / Desk Sets & Pads / Pens & Pen Holders / Letter Trays & Racks (office supplies, not office furniture), Bookends & Bookstands and Cocktail Table Books (books/decor), and every brands/* and collections/* page (§3 brand & collection listings - this site leans very heavily on them: 269 of its 416 en category URLs are brand or brand-collection pages).
